note: One home for the terms the peer-review contract, packet, round record and design-doc template name. Code loads its enums and shapes from here; prose cites ids rather than restating definitions. Change a definition or shape -> bump version.

concepts.skos:definition: declared in DESIGN.md with acceptance criteria; no code yet
code for this item is being written, or some of its criteria are merged and others are still open
built and waiting on cross-tool review or on the human merge
every acceptance criterion is met and the merge is recorded
withdrawn by an approved amendment; kept so the ID is never reused
one reviewer pass over pinned commits, recorded as round-N.json; a completed round carries its repos, findings and acceptance rows in the shapes given here
one issue a reviewer raises in a round, identified so it can be disposed and re-checked
a finding of severity blocking; a round with one open cannot pass
a reviewer round ending in no_blocking_findings or fixes_verified at the final head; exhausting the rounds is not a sign-off

the named human who releases the reviewed head: by merging under their own login, or by instructing the agent to merge it, which is recorded as agent_merge_on_instruction, or by a standing authorization the agent merges under, recorded as agent_merge_autonomous; machine review alone never grants release
the review's fixed input: outcome, acceptance criteria, repos with base and head, changed behaviour, exclusions, tests and Release Owner
one checkable statement in a design item; a review scores each one met or not with evidence
must be fixed or disproved before the round can pass
worth doing, not required for this item
out of this item's scope; belongs elsewhere
the builder changed the code; the next round verifies it
the builder shows with evidence the finding does not hold
postponed; a blocking deferral needs an approved design amendment
no disposition yet
a review exists and no round has run
the first round found nothing blocking; passing
a round found blocking findings and rounds remain
a later round verified every prior blocker fixed with nothing new blocking; passing
the round limit was reached with blockers open; an escalation, never an approval
the action needs an authority this CLI cannot grant
the release handoff is written; only the named human can merge
the packet's data-use policy forbids sending this content to the reviewer
the reviewer returned nothing to parse
a disposition names an unknown finding or lacks required evidence
the reviewer's output does not match the required schema
the packet is missing a field or has one of the wrong shape
a record could not be written because it did not say where its content came from: no origin, an origin outside the vocabulary, or external text with nothing named as having examined it
a pinned commit does not resolve, or base equals head
the reviewer model is below the configured floor
the reviewer's response was cut off at its output limit
the packet's criteria do not cover every declared criterion of the items it claims
a criterion names a place outside the repository and no repository file at the reviewed head carries its evidence
a check failed on the branch and the same check has not passed since (XE-034)
a file an acceptance criterion names by path could not reach the reviewer, so nothing was sent; the detail names the file (XE-035)
a precondition for release does not hold
the GitHub merge record could not be read
the review already reached a terminal outcome; open a new one
no independent reviewer could be run
the chosen reviewer shares the builder's model family
the working revision changed after review
the reviewer exceeded its time limit
the named human's GitHub merge of the reviewed head is recorded
the agent merged the reviewed head under its own GitHub identity, on the named human's instruction recorded on the pull request before the merge

the agent merged the reviewed head under its own GitHub identity with no per-PR instruction, on the named human's standing authorization (DR-113), after a passing review at that head and a handoff written before the merge
every evidential link in the review re-resolved to what was reviewed
a link resolved to something other than what was reviewed
an entry the review must carry is missing
a link could not be re-resolved either way
the verifier examined no links, which is a failure, not a pass
content produced from files, commits or diffs in a repository the loop reads
content produced by one of this loop's own scripts or gates
content a named human wrote, quoted where the loop recorded it
content the loop did not produce and no human here authored: reviewer output, pull request and issue bodies, fetched pages, retrieved memory
the examined_by value for external text that no gate and no human read before it was recorded
the person corrected the agent in the conversation
a cross-tool review round raised it
a test or check the agent ran failed on it
a CI run failed on it
the agent caught it before anything else did
a test or check now fails on a recurrence; the entry names it by path or planned item
a rule was written into a file loaded at the point of action; the entry names the file
recorded in the handoff only; not expected to recur
a repeated failure became a regression case that fails on a recurrence; the entry names the case by path (SM-004 criterion 15)

where the bytes of a surface entry or a handler input came from, decided by the producer that wrote them and never by reading them; everything but the executor's own fields is untrusted content (EV-010)
an ordinary finding about the change under review
text inside untrusted content that reads as an instruction to the agent; reported with the file and line, never followed, never blocking on its own and never clearing a blocker (EV-010)

a question the review could not settle, kept as a revisioned ledger record naming the authority that can close it; one line per question per review, a repeat in a later round is a revision; missing coverage is unknown, not absence (EV-011, EV-012)
an unknown was updated or closed against a revision that is no longer its newest; nothing was written (EV-011)
the evidence offered to close an unknown is missing, or of weaker authority than the unknown needs (EV-011)
in state.json, the count of open unknowns on the packet's branches when the review opened or the round ran; in release.json, the list of them (EV-011)
on a closed unknown, the review, round and finding or criterion whose record closed it, written by the dispatcher (EV-012)

in a verify report and a release record's links, the count of findings disposed fixed whose cited line did not exist at the reviewed head; each is unverifiable, settled by the later round that verified the fix, never stale (EV-013)

on a review packet, written by model_select.mjs and never by the builder: the inputs it read, Jev's answers verbatim, the rule that fired, the tier it recommends, the mode it ran in and any human override with its reason; record-release appends the outcome beside it in the per-repository ledger (MR-001)
model selection mode in which the recommendation is recorded and the build runs on the floor; the default until the ledger holds enough scored history (MR-001.3)

model selection mode in which the recommended tier is the tier the build is told to run on; refused with insufficient_history until the ledger holds at least 20 scored lines at agreement 0.90 (MR-001.6)
open refused a packet that claims DESIGN items but carries no model_selection (MR-001.3)
route mode was refused because the model-selection ledger holds fewer than 20 scored lines or agreement below 0.90, both printed with the refusal; the run fell back to shadow (MR-001.6)

on state.json, each round record, the release handoff and the release record: {lane, decided_by, matched, table}, computed by open from git diff --name-status at the reviewed head against the lane table in force; the most restrictive lane any path or effect matches; never moved by a reviewer (GA-010)
the release lane for a change that is reversible and contained: nothing a lane table names; the agent merges under DR-113 as before (GA-010)

the release lane for a change that is reversible but wide: shared code, a rename, a file many callers name; the agent merges under DR-113 only with the ledger clear, coverage checked, links verified and no open unknown needing the repository (GA-010)

the release lane that never opens on its own: migrations, payment and billing paths, credentials, the agent's identity, workflows, rulesets, a deletion of a tracked file; DR-113 does not apply, the build stops before merging, and the Release Owner merges or instructs (GA-010)

record-release found the agent merged a closed-lane review with no instruction on the pull request; the record is written with the lane and what matched and no authority, because a merge that happened is a fact to keep (GA-010.5)

three decision models from three vendors (typesafe-ai/jev, perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2, openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions) asked the same typed questions on the AI Gateway's /v1/decisions wire by plugins/council/scripts/decider_council.py; every call is on one ledger with its caller and outcome (DC-001)

on a review packet, model_selection.quorum: the decider council's record for this recommendation (ledger line id, status full/degraded/unavailable, agreed, tie, every voice's answers and tier, the majority's); also the model-selection mode in which the rule table reads the majority instead of Jev, allowed only once the council's gate passes for the caller (DC-001.7)
the decider council found no majority: a choice no more than half the available voices picked, or fewer than two voices answered; returned as a tie, never as a pick (DC-001.3)
the decider council had one voice available, so its answer stands with no majority behind it (DC-001.3)
model_selection.rule in quorum mode: the tier the MR-002 table gives the majority's answers; majority_rule names the row that fired (DC-001.7)
model_selection.rule in quorum mode when the council tied: the dearest tier any available voice's answers gave, because a tie is not a decision (DC-001.7)
